items.text: Anthropology and linguistics graduates can work in research, language technology, documentation of languages and cultures, market and design research, teaching and public programmes, and the careers open to those who add data, writing and one applied skill to their subject depth.
Pick an applied area, such as language technology, field research or heritage work, and build a portfolio of one study, one dataset and one writing sample.
Read the official notices of institutions and funding bodies.
